```{r}
#| label: shorten-long-path

create_shortcut <- function(path, short_cut, drive) {
  sub(gsub("\\)", "\\\\)", gsub("\\(", "\\\\(", short_cut)), paste0(drive, ":"), path)
}

if (nchar(dir_data) > 80) {
  system("subst x: /D")
  short_cut <- dirname(dir_home)
  system(paste0("subst x: \"", short_cut, "\""))

  dir_objects_names <- ls(pattern = "^dir_")
  dir_list <- mget(dir_objects_names)
  dir_list_shortened <- lapply(dir_list, function(y) create_shortcut(y, short_cut, "x"))
  list2env(dir_list_shortened, envir = .GlobalEnv)
}

rm(list = intersect(c("dir_objects_names", "short_cut", "dir_list", "dir_list_shortened"), ls()))
```

# Parameters

```{r parameters}
reactome_p_cutoff <- 0.05
reactome_fdr_cutoff <- 0.20
reactome_min_genes <- 3
reactome_top_terms_per_module <- 10
```

# Data

```{r load-data}
dir_wgcna <- fs::path(dir_temp_data, "WGCNA")

SOLAR_WGCNA_model <- readRDS(fs::path(dir_wgcna, "SOLAR_WGCNA_model.rds"))

proteomics_l <- readRDS(fs::path(
  dir_data,
  "ShARP_BHRC_Shared",
  "ShARP_BHRC_Data_Shared",
  "OLINK_proteomics_bridged_BHRC_SOLAR_CHS.rds"
))
```

```{r module-protein-inputs}
SOLAR_module_order <- SOLAR_WGCNA_model$reference$module_overview %>%
  dplyr::filter(module != "grey") %>%
  dplyr::arrange(dplyr::desc(n_proteins), module) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(module_label = paste0("M", dplyr::row_number()))

SOLAR_protein_labels <- proteomics_l$protein_annotation$SOLAR %>%
  dplyr::transmute(
    protein = meta_id,
    protein_symbol = dplyr::coalesce(meta_Assay, meta_id)
  ) %>%
  dplyr::distinct(protein, .keep_all = TRUE)

SOLAR_reference_module_proteins <- SOLAR_WGCNA_model$reference$wgcna$module_df %>%
  dplyr::filter(module != "grey") %>%
  dplyr::left_join(SOLAR_module_order, by = "module") %>%
  dplyr::left_join(SOLAR_protein_labels, by = "protein") %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    module_label = factor(module_label, levels = SOLAR_module_order$module_label),
    protein_symbol = dplyr::coalesce(protein_symbol, protein)
  )

SOLAR_reference_module_proteins %>%
  dplyr::count(module_label, module, name = "n_proteins") %>%
  dplyr::arrange(module_label) %>%
  dplyr::select(
    `Module` = module_label,
    `Module color` = module,
    `Proteins in module` = n_proteins
  ) %>%
  kableExtra::kbl(caption = "SOLAR reference WGCNA modules included in pathway analysis.") %>%
  kableExtra::kable_paper("hover", full_width = FALSE)
```

# Protein Identifier Mapping

```{r map-proteins}
SOLAR_reference_entrez_map <- map_proteins_to_entrez(
  SOLAR_reference_module_proteins$protein_symbol,
  from_type = "SYMBOL"
) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(ENTREZID = as.character(ENTREZID))

SOLAR_reference_module_entrez <- SOLAR_reference_module_proteins %>%
  dplyr::left_join(
    SOLAR_reference_entrez_map,
    by = c("protein_symbol" = "SYMBOL")
  )

SOLAR_reference_module_entrez %>%
  dplyr::summarise(
    n_module_proteins = dplyr::n_distinct(protein),
    n_mapped_proteins = dplyr::n_distinct(protein[!is.na(ENTREZID)]),
    pct_mapped = 100 * n_mapped_proteins / n_module_proteins
  ) %>%
  kableExtra::kbl(
    digits = 1,
    caption = "Entrez ID mapping summary for SOLAR reference module proteins."
  ) %>%
  kableExtra::kable_paper("hover", full_width = FALSE)

SOLAR_reference_module_entrez %>%
  dplyr::group_by(module_label, module) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(
    n_module_proteins = dplyr::n_distinct(protein),
    n_mapped_proteins = dplyr::n_distinct(protein[!is.na(ENTREZID)]),
    pct_mapped = 100 * n_mapped_proteins / n_module_proteins,
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  dplyr::arrange(module_label) %>%
  dplyr::select(
    `Module` = module_label,
    `Module color` = module,
    `Proteins in module` = n_module_proteins,
    `Proteins mapped to Entrez ID` = n_mapped_proteins,
    `% mapped` = pct_mapped
  ) %>%
  kableExtra::kbl(
    digits = 1,
    caption = "Protein identifier mapping by SOLAR reference WGCNA module."
  ) %>%
  kableExtra::kable_paper("hover", full_width = FALSE)
```

# Reactome Enrichment

```{r reactome-enrichment}
SOLAR_reference_reactome_results <- purrr::map_dfr(
  levels(SOLAR_reference_module_entrez$module_label),
  function(current_module_label) {
    module_df <- SOLAR_reference_module_entrez %>%
      dplyr::filter(module_label == current_module_label)

    module_name <- paste(unique(module_df$module), collapse = ", ")

    run_reactome_enrichment_entrez(
      df = module_df,
      universe_df = SOLAR_reference_module_entrez,
      group_name = current_module_label,
      entrez_col = "ENTREZID",
      p_cutoff = reactome_p_cutoff,
      padj_cutoff = reactome_fdr_cutoff,
      min_genes = reactome_min_genes
    ) %>%
      dplyr::mutate(
        module_label = current_module_label,
        module = module_name,
        .before = enrichment_group
      )
  }
)

reactome_required_columns <- list(
  ID = NA_character_,
  Description = NA_character_,
  GeneRatio = NA_character_,
  BgRatio = NA_character_,
  pvalue = NA_real_,
  p.adjust = NA_real_,
  geneID = NA_character_,
  RichFactor = NA_real_,
  sig_p = NA,
  sig_fdr = NA,
  Description_clean = NA_character_
)

for (column_name in names(reactome_required_columns)) {
  if (!column_name %in% names(SOLAR_reference_reactome_results)) {
    SOLAR_reference_reactome_results[[column_name]] <- reactome_required_columns[[column_name]]
  }
}

SOLAR_reference_reactome_summary <- SOLAR_reference_reactome_results %>%
  dplyr::group_by(module_label, module) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(
    n_input = max(n_input, na.rm = TRUE),
    n_reactome_terms = sum(!is.na(ID)),
    n_terms_p_lt_0_05 = sum(sig_p, na.rm = TRUE),
    n_terms_fdr_lt_0_05 = sum(p.adjust < 0.05, na.rm = TRUE),
    n_terms_fdr_lt_0_20 = sum(sig_fdr, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  dplyr::arrange(module_label)

SOLAR_reference_reactome_summary %>%
  dplyr::select(
    `Module` = module_label,
    `Module color` = module,
    `Mapped input genes` = n_input,
    `Reactome terms tested` = n_reactome_terms,
    `Terms with p < 0.05` = n_terms_p_lt_0_05,
    `Terms with FDR < 0.05` = n_terms_fdr_lt_0_05,
    `Terms with FDR < 0.20` = n_terms_fdr_lt_0_20
  ) %>%
  kableExtra::kbl(caption = "Reactome pathway enrichment summary by SOLAR reference WGCNA module.") %>%
  kableExtra::kable_paper("hover", full_width = FALSE)
```

```{r top-reactome-terms}
SOLAR_reference_reactome_top_terms <- SOLAR_reference_reactome_results %>%
  dplyr::filter(!is.na(ID)) %>%
  dplyr::group_by(module_label, module) %>%
  dplyr::arrange(p.adjust, pvalue, .by_group = TRUE) %>%
  dplyr::slice_head(n = reactome_top_terms_per_module) %>%
  dplyr::ungroup()

SOLAR_reference_reactome_top_terms %>%
  dplyr::select(
    `Module` = module_label,
    `Module color` = module,
    `Reactome pathway` = Description,
    `Input genes / pathway genes` = GeneRatio,
    `Background ratio` = BgRatio,
    `P value` = pvalue,
    `FDR` = p.adjust,
    `Input proteins` = geneID
  ) %>%
  kableExtra::kbl(
    digits = 3,
    caption = "Top Reactome pathways enriched within each SOLAR reference WGCNA module."
  ) %>%
  kableExtra::kable_paper("hover", full_width = FALSE)
```

# Visualization

```{r reactome-dotplot, fig.width=11, fig.height=8}
SOLAR_reference_reactome_plot_modules <- c("M3", "M5", "M6", "M8")
SOLAR_reference_reactome_plot_fdr_cutoff <- 0.05

reactome_scalar <- function(x, default = NA_character_) {
  if (is.null(x) || length(x) == 0) {
    return(default)
  }
  as.character(x[[1]])
}

get_reactome_event_hierarchy <- function(species_id = 9606) {
  empty_hierarchy <- list(
    nodes = tibble::tibble(id = character(), name = character()),
    edges = tibble::tibble(parent_id = character(), child_id = character()),
    available = FALSE
  )

  if (!requireNamespace("jsonlite", quietly = TRUE)) {
    return(empty_hierarchy)
  }

  hierarchy_url <- paste0(
    "https://reactome.org/ContentService/data/eventsHierarchy/",
    species_id
  )

  hierarchy_tree <- tryCatch(
    jsonlite::fromJSON(hierarchy_url, simplifyVector = FALSE),
    error = function(e) NULL
  )

  if (is.null(hierarchy_tree)) {
    return(empty_hierarchy)
  }

  nodes <- list()
  edges <- list()

  walk_reactome_node <- function(node, parent_id = NA_character_) {
    node_id <- reactome_scalar(node$stId)
    node_name <- reactome_scalar(node$name)

    if (!is.na(node_id)) {
      nodes[[length(nodes) + 1]] <<- tibble::tibble(id = node_id, name = node_name)

      if (!is.na(parent_id)) {
        edges[[length(edges) + 1]] <<- tibble::tibble(parent_id = parent_id, child_id = node_id)
      }
    }

    if (!is.null(node$children) && length(node$children) > 0) {
      purrr::walk(node$children, walk_reactome_node, parent_id = node_id)
    }
  }

  purrr::walk(hierarchy_tree, walk_reactome_node)

  list(
    nodes = dplyr::bind_rows(nodes) %>% dplyr::distinct(),
    edges = dplyr::bind_rows(edges) %>% dplyr::distinct(),
    available = length(nodes) > 0 && length(edges) > 0
  )
}

get_reactome_descendant_ids <- function(edges, ancestor_id) {
  descendant_ids <- character()
  frontier <- ancestor_id

  while (length(frontier) > 0) {
    child_ids <- unique(edges$child_id[edges$parent_id %in% frontier])
    child_ids <- setdiff(child_ids, c(descendant_ids, ancestor_id))
    descendant_ids <- union(descendant_ids, child_ids)
    frontier <- child_ids
  }

  descendant_ids
}

remove_parent_reactome_terms_by_genes <- function(df) {
  if (nrow(df) <= 1) {
    return(rep(FALSE, nrow(df)))
  }

  gene_sets <- stringr::str_split(df$geneID, "/")
  drop_parent <- rep(FALSE, nrow(df))

  for (parent_index in seq_len(nrow(df))) {
    parent_genes <- gene_sets[[parent_index]]

    for (child_index in seq_len(nrow(df))) {
      child_genes <- gene_sets[[child_index]]

      if (
        parent_index != child_index &&
          length(parent_genes) > length(child_genes) &&
          all(child_genes %in% parent_genes)
      ) {
        drop_parent[parent_index] <- TRUE
        break
      }
    }
  }

  drop_parent
}

reactome_hierarchy <- get_reactome_event_hierarchy()

infectious_disease_ids <- reactome_hierarchy$nodes %>%
  dplyr::filter(name == "Infectious disease") %>%
  dplyr::pull(id)

infectious_disease_descendant_ids <- unique(c(
  infectious_disease_ids,
  purrr::map(infectious_disease_ids, ~ get_reactome_descendant_ids(reactome_hierarchy$edges, .x)) %>%
    unlist(use.names = FALSE)
))

annotate_reactome_plot_exclusions <- function(df) {
  if (nrow(df) == 0) {
    return(df)
  }

  if (isTRUE(reactome_hierarchy$available)) {
    child_pathways <- purrr::map_chr(
      df$ID,
      function(pathway_id) {
        child_ids_in_module <- intersect(
          get_reactome_descendant_ids(reactome_hierarchy$edges, pathway_id),
          setdiff(df$ID, pathway_id)
        )

        paste(df$Description_clean[match(child_ids_in_module, df$ID)], collapse = "; ")
      }
    )

    remove_parent_pathway <- child_pathways != ""
    parent_filter_source <- "Reactome hierarchy"
  } else {
    remove_parent_pathway <- remove_parent_reactome_terms_by_genes(df)
    child_pathways <- rep(NA_character_, nrow(df))
    parent_filter_source <- "Input-gene containment fallback"
  }

  remove_infectious_disease <- df$ID %in% infectious_disease_descendant_ids
  infectious_filter_source <- "Reactome Disease > Infectious disease hierarchy"

  df %>%
    dplyr::mutate(
      remove_parent_pathway = remove_parent_pathway,
      child_pathways_in_module = child_pathways,
      parent_filter_source = parent_filter_source,
      remove_infectious_disease = remove_infectious_disease,
      infectious_filter_source = infectious_filter_source,
      remove_from_plot = remove_parent_pathway | remove_infectious_disease,
      removal_reason = dplyr::case_when(
        remove_parent_pathway & remove_infectious_disease ~ "Parent pathway; infectious disease pathway",
        remove_parent_pathway ~ "Parent pathway",
        remove_infectious_disease ~ "Infectious disease pathway",
        TRUE ~ NA_character_
      )
    )
}

SOLAR_reference_reactome_terms_plot_candidates <- SOLAR_reference_reactome_results %>%
  dplyr::filter(
    module_label %in% SOLAR_reference_reactome_plot_modules,
    !is.na(ID),
    p.adjust < SOLAR_reference_reactome_plot_fdr_cutoff
  ) %>%
  dplyr::group_by(module_label) %>%
  dplyr::group_modify(~ annotate_reactome_plot_exclusions(.x)) %>%
  dplyr::ungroup()

reactome_plot_annotation_columns <- list(
  remove_parent_pathway = logical(),
  child_pathways_in_module = character(),
  parent_filter_source = character(),
  remove_infectious_disease = logical(),
  infectious_filter_source = character(),
  remove_from_plot = logical(),
  removal_reason = character()
)

for (column_name in names(reactome_plot_annotation_columns)) {
  if (!column_name %in% names(SOLAR_reference_reactome_terms_plot_candidates)) {
    SOLAR_reference_reactome_terms_plot_candidates[[column_name]] <-
      reactome_plot_annotation_columns[[column_name]]
  }
}

SOLAR_reference_reactome_terms_removed_from_plot <- SOLAR_reference_reactome_terms_plot_candidates %>%
  dplyr::filter(remove_from_plot)

SOLAR_reference_reactome_terms_plot <- SOLAR_reference_reactome_terms_plot_candidates %>%
  dplyr::filter(!remove_from_plot) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    module_label = factor(module_label, levels = SOLAR_reference_reactome_plot_modules),
    Description_short = stringr::str_wrap(Description_clean, width = 45),
    neg_log10_fdr = -log10(pmax(p.adjust, .Machine$double.xmin)),
    Description_short = forcats::fct_reorder(Description_short, neg_log10_fdr, .fun = max)
  )

tibble::tibble(
  `Reactome hierarchy available` = reactome_hierarchy$available,
  `Infectious disease Reactome IDs found` = paste(infectious_disease_ids, collapse = "; "),
  `Infectious disease descendants found` = length(infectious_disease_descendant_ids)
) %>%
  kableExtra::kbl(caption = "Reactome hierarchy filtering status.") %>%
  kableExtra::kable_paper("hover", full_width = FALSE)

SOLAR_reference_reactome_terms_removed_from_plot %>%
  dplyr::arrange(module_label, removal_reason, p.adjust, pvalue) %>%
  dplyr::select(
    `Module` = module_label,
    `Reactome pathway` = Description_clean,
    `Reactome ID` = ID,
    `Removal reason` = removal_reason,
    `Child pathways in same module` = child_pathways_in_module,
    `Parent filter source` = parent_filter_source,
    `Infectious filter source` = infectious_filter_source,
    `FDR` = p.adjust,
    `P value` = pvalue
  ) %>%
  kableExtra::kbl(
    digits = 3,
    caption = "Reactome pathways filtered out before plotting."
  ) %>%
  kableExtra::kable_paper("hover", full_width = FALSE)

SOLAR_reference_reactome_terms_plot %>%
  dplyr::arrange(module_label, p.adjust, pvalue) %>%
  dplyr::select(
    `Module` = module_label,
    `Reactome pathway kept for plot` = Description_clean,
    `Reactome ID` = ID,
    `FDR` = p.adjust,
    `P value` = pvalue
  ) %>%
  kableExtra::kbl(
    digits = 3,
    caption = "Reactome pathways retained for plotting after filtering."
  ) %>%
  kableExtra::kable_paper("hover", full_width = FALSE)

if (nrow(SOLAR_reference_reactome_terms_plot) == 0) {
  ggplot2::ggplot() +
    ggplot2::annotate(
      "text",
      x = 0,
      y = 0,
      label = paste0(
        "No Reactome pathways with FDR < ",
        SOLAR_reference_reactome_plot_fdr_cutoff,
        " returned for the selected modules."
      )
    ) +
    ggplot2::theme_void()
} else {
  SOLAR_reference_reactome_terms_plot %>%
    ggplot2::ggplot(ggplot2::aes(
      x = neg_log10_fdr,
      y = Description_short,
      size = RichFactor
    )) +
    ggplot2::geom_point(alpha = 0.85, color = "black") +
    ggplot2::facet_grid(module_label ~ ., scales = "free_y", space = "free_y") +
    ggplot2::scale_size_continuous(name = "Rich factor", range = c(1, 4)) +
    ggplot2::labs(
      x = "-log10(BH-FDR)",
      y = NULL
    ) +
    ggplot2::theme_bw(base_size = 10) +
    ggplot2::theme(
      text = ggplot2::element_text(color = "black"),
      panel.grid.major.y = ggplot2::element_line(color = "grey90", linewidth = 0.2),
      panel.grid.minor = ggplot2::element_blank(),
      legend.position = "right",
      strip.text.y = ggplot2::element_text(angle = 0)
    )
}
```
